title: From Christmas Markets to Caribbean Shores: Celebrate the Holidays with Hilton Hotels & Resorts
summary: Holiday travel makes the season even more magical. Discover unforgettable ways to celebrate the season with Hilton Hotels & Resorts.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


Whether dreaming of Europe's enchanting Christmas markets or Mexico's sun‑drenched beaches, discover unforgettable ways to celebrate the season with Hilton Hotels & Resorts


- **Discover the best holiday destinations for every type of traveler, from festive European capitals and New York City's iconic seasonal attractions to tropical escapes in Mexico and the Caribbean.**
- **Embrace classic holiday traditions with charming Christmas markets, dazzling light displays, seasonal treats and memorable cultural experiences or trade winter coats for swimsuits at Hilton Hotels & Resorts properties offering beachfront celebrations, family-friendly activities and relaxing retreats that bring a tropical twist to the holidays.**
- **Whether dreaming of a winter wonderland or a sunny seaside escape, Hilton Hotels & Resorts brings travelers closer to the destinations and experiences that make celebrating the season easier and more enjoyable.**


Holiday travel makes the season even more magical. For many, a December getaway conjures images of snow-covered scenery, steaming mugs of mulled wine and bustling Christmas markets filled with tempting treats. For others, the ultimate holiday gift is an escape from the cold, where palm trees and sandy beaches offer a soothing respite filled with sunshine and relaxation.


Fortunately, there's no one-size-fits-all approach to celebrating the season. In fact,[Hilton's 2027 Trends Report](https://stories.hilton.com/2027-trends) reveals that travelers are increasingly prioritizing experiences that feel personal and authentic, rather than chasing the "perfect" vacation. Whether Europe's storybook cities are calling, or the laid-back islands of the Caribbean prove tempting, travelers can find festive experiences that fulfill their holiday wish list. And wherever they may roam, enchanting Hilton Hotels & Resorts is ready to host the holidays, bringing people together through signature hospitality, destination-driven dining and locally inspired experiences that connect travelers to the places they’ve come to celebrate.


## For Holiday Traditionalists: Festive Markets, Twinkling Lights and Winter Magic


For travelers who believe the holidays require cozy scarves, glittering decorations and centuries-old traditions, these destinations deliver an abundance of seasonal enchantment.


### Vienna, Austria: A Storybook Come to Life


Hilton Vienna Park - Lenz


The magic of Christmas can be found waiting around every corner in Vienna. With more than 20 festive holiday markets scattered across the Austrian capital, the city is transformed into a winter wonderland filled with picture-perfect stalls selling handcrafted ornaments and the irresistible aroma of roasted chestnuts filling the air.


At the heart of the festivities is the beloved Rathausplatz Christmas market, where the impressive City Hall building provides a dramatic backdrop for seasonal shopping and revelry.[Hilton Vienna Park](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/viehitw-hilton-vienna-park/) offers a convenient home base for festive Vienna travelers, where guests can sip on cocktails at[Selleny's Bar](https://sellenys-bar.at/en/) or savor Austrian-inspired cuisine at[LENZ](https://lenz-socialdining.at/en/) between exploring the city’s seasonal sights.


For those seeking a stay close to St. Stephen's Cathedral and the city's many seasonal attractions,[Hilton Vienna Plaza](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/viepwtw-hilton-vienna-plaza/) offers an elegant Art Deco landmark along the Ringstrasse. Meanwhile, those craving a quieter retreat will love[Hilton Vienna Waterfront](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/viehahi-hilton-vienna-waterfront/) , which boasts a scenic setting along the Danube. Here, travelers can unwind and discover seasonal Austrian specialties, including[traditional Christmas carp](https://stories.hilton.com/destination-spotlight/culinary-traditions-from-holiday-tables-around-the-world) , at[OXBO Restaurant](https://oxbo-viennawaterfront.at/en/) .


### Budapest, Hungary: Splendor Along the Danube


Hilton Budapest - Aerial


Another charming destination along the Danube River lies Budapest, where grand architecture and festive traditions make for an alluring wintertime European escape. During the holiday season, the Hungarian capital glows with Christmas lights as bustling markets invite visitors to browse handmade gifts and sample local specialties.


The Advent Feast at St. Stephen's Basilica and the Christmas Fair at Vörösmarty Square are among the city's most popular seasonal attractions, offering everything from traditional chimney cakes to hearty Hungarian comfort foods. Amid it all, perched in the historic Castle District beside Fisherman's Bastion and Matthias Church, is[Hilton Budapest](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/budhitw-hilton-budapest/) . As the landmark hotel prepares to celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2027, guests can experience its enduring appeal after dark, taking in breathtaking views of the illuminated Parliament building and the Danube from[White Raven Skybar & Lounge](https://whiteravenskybar.com/) , a lively gathering spot for a memorable holiday toast.


### London, England: A Capital Dressed for Christmas


-
-


London Hilton on Park Lane - Holiday Area


Further north, always-enticing London knows how to put on a holiday show. From the glittering lights of Regent Street and Oxford Street to tantalizing Christmas markets, seasonal pop-ups and spectacular decorations throughout the capital, the city offers endless opportunities to celebrate the most wonderful time of year.


Guests can stay overlooking Hyde Park at[London Hilton on Park Lane](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/lonhitw-london-hilton-on-park-lane/) , which places travelers within easy reach of some of London's most celebrated seasonal attractions. Set in the heart of Mayfair, the hotel offers a taste of the destination at[Park Corner Brasserie](https://www.parkcornerbrasserie.com/) , where Modern British cuisine provides an inviting place to gather over a festive meal, all surrounded by the charm of one of London’s most iconic neighborhoods.


St. Pancras Christmas Tree 2026 - Photo Credit: Sam Lane Photography/St Pancras Christmas Tree 2026


Not far from the hotel, Hilton is also bringing a touch of German Christmas tradition to the heart of London through a partnership with St. Pancras and the German National Tourist Office. At St. Pancras International,[an 11-metre Christmas tree](https://stpancras-highspeed.com/news-events/st-pancras-international-christmas-tree-2026/) , inspired by a traditional German Christmas pyramid, reimagines its intricate wooden construction on a spectacular scale. Three rotating tiers showcase landmarks from across the country, while 24 layered wooden “curiosity windows” shine a light on German culture and festive traditions from Hilton. From Dec. 1, one window will illuminate each day in the countdown to Christmas Eve, giving visitors the chance to win prizes including Hilton stays across Germany and the grand prize of becoming a Hilton Honors Millionaire in time for Christmas. It’s a must-see for anyone visiting London this holiday season.


### New York City: Big-City Holiday Magic


Hilton New York Times Square - 42nd and Sky


New York City proves that it’s not just Europe that knows how to celebrate in style. The Big Apple is overflowing with dazzling displays during the holidays. Visitors can take in the towering Christmas tree and ice-skating rink at Rockefeller Center, the elaborate Fifth Avenue window dressings and the lively Christmas markets at Bryant Park and Union Square.


Midtown Manhattan is the place to be, and[New York Hilton Midtown](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/nycnhhh-new-york-hilton-midtown/) puts guests close to many of the city’s iconic attractions, with seasonal dishes at the on-site Herb N' Kitchen, offering a welcome opportunity to refuel between adventures. After a full day taking in the city’s holiday magic, Hilton Honors members can enjoy added convenience with the Hilton Honors app, using Digital Key to access their room right from their phone. For a front-row view of the festivities,[Hilton New York Times Square](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/nyctshh-hilton-times-square/) places travelers near Broadway theaters and seasonal shopping, with a transformed sky lobby and craft cocktail lounge overlooking the bright lights and unmistakable holiday energy of Times Square.


## For Sunshine Seekers: Tropical Traditions and Beachfront Celebrations


Of course, not everyone dreams of a white Christmas. For travelers wanting to kick off their fuzzy socks in favor of flip-flops, these warm-weather destinations offer a different kind of holiday magic.


### Cancún, Mexico: A Family-Friendly Beachfront Holiday


Who says Santa needs snow? In Cancún, families can celebrate the holidays with sunshine, sandy beaches and plenty of festive fun at[Hilton Cancun Mar Caribe All-Inclusive Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cunmchh-hilton-cancun-mar-caribe-all-inclusive-resort/) . Here, guests can enjoy a tropical spin on the season, with special activities that include a Christmas tree lighting show, poolside visits from Santa and gingerbread house making. Hilton Honors members can make the getaway even more rewarding by redeeming Points for an all-inclusive stay, leaving more time to focus on celebrating together.


Beyond the festivities, the resort offers something for every generation. Younger guests can enjoy activities at the Beach Bunch kids' club, while teens have their own hangout at Sandbar Social. Parents can retreat to the adults-only pool or unwind in an Enclave suite with a private plunge pool, making it easy to mix family togetherness time with some well-deserved relaxation.


### Denarau Island, Fiji: Festive Island Spirit in the South Pacific


Hilton Fiji Beach Resort & Spa - Nuku Ginger Bread House


For travelers dreaming of swapping winter chill for an island Christmas,[Hilton Fiji Beach Resort & Spa](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/nanhihi-hilton-fiji-beach-resort-and-spa/) offers a sun-soaked setting for celebrating the season in the South Pacific.


Set along 2.5km prime beachfront on Denarau Island, the resort gives families and couples the chance to slow down and spend the holidays together, with Fiji’s warm hospitality providing a distinctly local backdrop to the festivities. Christmas tree lighting, live Christmas choir, and Santa grand appearances bring seasonal cheer to the island, while relaxed days by the water offer plenty of opportunities to recharge between celebrations. It’s a tropical take on treasured traditions, where guests can spend Christmas under swaying palms and welcome the New Year surrounded by Pacific Ocean views. ****


### Tulum, Mexico: A Tropical Escape with Something for Everyone


Mexico's Riviera Maya is a spectacular coastal setting that begs to be explored. At[Hilton Tulum Riviera Maya All-Inclusive Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cunhihh-hilton-tulum-riviera-maya-all-inclusive-resort/) , families can fill their days with sunshine and adventure across nine pools, a Splash Park and a dedicated Family Zone. Movie nights and piñata-making activities add extra fun for younger travelers, while adults can relax by the pool or enjoy a rejuvenating spa treatment at[Conrad Spa Tulum,](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cuncici-conrad-tulum-riviera-maya/spa/) located at the neighboring[Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya, an All-Inclusive Resort](https://conradtulumrivieramaya.com/) **.**


And when it comes time to gather around the holiday table, the resort's 12 all-inclusive dining options offer plenty of opportunities to celebrate the season over a memorable meal. It's a wintertime getaway where the greatest gift of all is finding more time to connect.


### Puerto Vallarta, Mexico: Big-Time Adventure in the Sun


Hilton Vallarta Riviera All-Inclusive Resort - Festive Decor


In Puerto Vallarta, the holiday season brings a delightful combination of festive lights, warm weather and unforgettable outdoor experiences. Here, families staying at[Hilton Vallarta Riviera All-Inclusive Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/pvrpahh-hilton-vallarta-riviera-all-inclusive-resort/) can swap snowball fights for splashing in the Family Zone pools and water playground, while mini-chef classes and a lively mini-disco add to the fun.


Beyond the resort, the winter months coincide with whale-watching season in Banderas Bay, offering travelers an opportunity to spot humpback whales in the surrounding Pacific waters. With spectacular coastal scenery and plenty of ways to celebrate together, it's the perfect destination to savor a holiday escape from winter's chill.


### Burau Bay, Langkawi: Festive Magic by the Shores


Hilton Burau Bay Langkawi Resort - Festive Dining


At[Hilton Burau Bay Langkawi Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/lgkbbhi-hilton-burau-bay-langkawi-resort/) , festive celebrations come with sun-kissed shores, lush tropical surroundings and the Andaman Sea just steps away. Set along Langkawi's scenic coastline, the resort invites travelers to embrace the holidays with barefoot moments by the beach, bringing together cherished traditions, joyful celebrations and the easy rhythm of island living.


Throughout December, the festive spirit unfolds across the resort with experiences designed for families, couples and friends. Little ones can look forward to Santa Claus appearances, gingerbread decorating, Christmas crafts, festive face painting and family games, while guests seeking a slower pace can enjoy beachfront yoga and nature-inspired activities. The celebrations extend to the dining table, from festive buffets and live entertainment at Gingerfire to Italian-inspired Christmas dining at Trattoria Mare and specially curated Cantonese menus at MINGZHU. At Haliya Lounge, the festive indulgence continues with fragrant gingerbread, rich Christmas cakes and an assortment of handcrafted sweet treats, offering a delicious taste of the season.


As 2026 draws to a close, the celebrations shift to the shoreline, where New Year's Eve brings beachfront festivities, live music, fire shows and a spectacular fireworks display beneath the tropical night sky. Beyond the dining table, it is the moments shared that make the season memorable, whether gathering with loved ones, embracing the warmth of the holidays or welcoming the New Year by the sea. At Hilton Burau Bay Langkawi Resort, the magic of the festive season meets the beauty of an island escape, creating memories to carry well beyond the celebrations. ****


### Oranjestad, Aruba: A Holiday Toast with Caribbean Views


For those dreaming of a grown-up holiday getaway for two, Aruba offers the perfect setting to slow down, unwind and indulge in spectacular ocean views. With its powdery beaches and seemingly endless sunshine, this island is an idyllic destination for couples seeking a relaxing holiday hideaway.


Take it all in from[The Westerly at Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort & Casino](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/auahhhh-hilton-aruba-caribbean-resort-and-casino/the-westerly/) , where guests can enjoy Terrace on 10, an elevated rooftop venue offering panoramic ocean vistas and live entertainment, before retreating to spacious accommodations with private balconies. Want the ultimate Christmas present? Indulge in a ground-floor room that features an adults-only swim-up plunge pool.


Between treatments at[eforea Spa](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/auahhhh-hilton-aruba-caribbean-resort-and-casino/things-to-do/spa/) and afternoons spent lounging along the beach, this is an irresistible place where couples can enjoy a slower, sunnier take on the holiday season.


### Los Cabos, Mexico: Coastal Luxury for Two


Hilton Los Cabos - Pool - Photo Credit: Victor Elias Photography


Found where the desert meets the sea, Los Cabos delivers a dramatic setting for couples craving a holiday escape filled with rejuvenation, romance and memorable dining. For the ultimate stay,[Hilton Los Cabos Beach & Golf Resort](https://www.hiltonloscabos.com/) , situated along one of the region's rare cove-protected beaches, invites lovebirds to unwind at the adults-only[Enclave Beach Club](https://www.hiltonloscabos.com/enclave/) or indulge in revitalizing treatments at[eforea Spa](https://www.hiltonloscabos.com/spa/) .


The resort celebrates the season spectacularly, with a Thanksgiving table set against the sunset, a Christmas dinner that takes inspiration from Baja’s own local ingredients and a New Year’s celebration that includes a seated dinner, followed by dancing on the sand as midnight arrives and fireworks explode over the Sea of Cortez. The party here never ends, and through it all, guests can choose from eight distinct dining venues, including oceanfront Mediterranean fare at[Vela](https://www.hiltonloscabos.com/restaurants-bars/vela/) and wood-fired coastal cuisine at[Leña](https://www.hiltonloscabos.com/restaurants-bars/lena/) .


With warm days, stunning coastal scenery and plenty of opportunities to linger over a memorable meal, the resort offers an inviting alternative to the traditional holiday rush.


### Key West, Florida: Island-Style Holiday Cheer


Hilton Key West Resort & Marina - Exterior Aerial


In Key West, holiday traditions come with a quirky, tropical twist. Instead of snow-covered rooftops, visitors can find a festive calendar of events that include the Harbor Walk of Lights and the beloved Lighted Boat Parade, where illuminated vessels bring extra magic to the waterfront. And for a truly unconventional way to ring in the new year, the iconic Conch Shell drop on Duval Street delights.


Just minutes from the festivities,[Hilton Key West Resort & Marina](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/eywhhhh-hilton-key-west-resort-and-marina/) offers a convenient base for soaking up the island's holiday spirit. With marina-front accommodations, waterfront dining and Key West's laid-back charm, it's a destination where couples can celebrate the season without ever needing a winter coat.


## Find the Ideal Home Away From Home this Holiday Season


This holiday season, there are so many great ways to celebrate. Whether strolling through a centuries-old Christmas market beneath a canopy of twinkling lights or watching the sunset from a palm-lined beach, travelers can discover a memorable getaway filled with snow or sand.


From Vienna to New York, Aruba, Mexico and beyond, Hilton Hotels & Resorts invites travelers to embrace the magic of the season in any destination.
